channel.title: RNZ Media & Technology Headlines
channel.description: The Latest Media & Technology headlines from RNZ News

item.title: Te Karere Māori news bulletin has funding slashed
item.description: Funding for the long-standing Māori news bulletin Te Karere has been slashed, while current affairs programme The Hui has had their funding cut completely. The announcement comes from Māori media...

item.title: Do we need to be saying 'please' and 'thanks' to AI?
item.description: Why are people being nice to AI? And does it actually make any difference?

item.title: How do I know if my teen is entangled in 'toxic masculinity'?
item.description: What does it mean? How can you tell? And what to do about it if you think it's picking up steam.

item.title: Morning Report's Corin Dann appointed RNZ’s new Business Editor
Our Changing World: Putting AI to use in Aotearoa
item.description: From modelling measles outbreaks to keeping track of Wellington's exploding kākā population, researchers are calling on AI to assist them with a vast array of projects.

item.title: The man who's never owned a cellphone
item.description: Even the Kiwi professor's mates are baffled, asking 'when are you going to move into the 21st century?'.

item.title: RNZ closes down TAHI youth platform
item.description: RNZ has announced it will close its TAHI youth platform as part of a number of changes to how the broadcaster covers music, arts and culture.

item.title: Trust and Tech: Where should RNZ draw the line on AI?
item.description: Editorial - Artificial Intelligence is everywhere, but we can still make deliberate decisions about how we use it.

item.title: Lawyers challenge widespread police use of number-plate software as evidence
item.description: Police reportedly tap into the Auckland-based Auror system 250,000 times a year, often outside big retailers and petrol stations.

item.title: Listen up: Why listening to stories still matters for kids of all ages
item.description: Taranaki author David Hill looks back on RNZ's proud tradition of sharing stories for little listeners.

item.title: 'I wasted seven years of my life not being on that journey' Mike McRoberts' journey to reclaim his reo
item.description: The broadcaster has been open about his struggles to reclaim his ancestral language.

item.title: 'The AI chatbot helped her write a suicide note'
item.description: Sophie Rottenberg took her own life after interacting ChatGPT-based AI therapist named Harry. Warning: This story discusses suicide.

item.title: How can I put my phone down and stop doomscrolling?
item.description: It starts with one simple task on your phone. Next minute, you've been endlessly scrolling social media for an hour.

item.title: Is this TikTok star really Kiwi actor KJ Apa?
item.description: Fans have been digging for clues to find out if the Kiwi actor is behind an alter ego singer sporting a wig and funky outfits.

item.title: RNZ-ABC series on Rainbow Warrior sinking scoops major prize at Asia Podcast Awards
item.description: The series looks at the "collateral damage" to a Pacific people hit hard by nuclear testing.

item.title: Who is Anna Wintour's replacement at Vogue?
item.description: Vogue has announced that Chloe Malle will head up the fashion magazine's US edition, replacing world-renowned figure Anna Wintour.
